run_experiment_with_sequence_model: run a BenchMARL experiment using a SequenceModelConfig with multiple MLP layers and intermediate sizes
create_sequence_model_config: create a SequenceModelConfig with a list of MlpConfig models and intermediate output sizes
configure_mlp_from_yaml: configure an MLP model by loading default settings from the benchmarl YAML config file
configure_mlp_manually: configure an MLP model manually with custom num_cells, activation_class, and layer_class parameters
run_vmas_balance_task: run a VmasTask BALANCE experiment using MappoConfig algorithm with a sequence model and critic model
